title: Accuracy is not enough: explainable boosting machine model and identification of candidate biomarkers for real-time sepsis risk assessment in the emergency department.
ambiguity_note: Structurally a single-point classifier (not continuous monitoring like Deep EDICAS), leans toward included intake/early-risk-flagging pattern. But 'positive blood culture' as a top feature suggests assessment happens well into the workup, and 'real-time decision support' reads more like a treatment/antibiotics-initiation trigger than intake/triage/disposition -- could instead match the CPR-type exclusion precedent. Gates 2/3 clear pass: EBM inherently interpretable, actual global-explanation output reported (top biomarkers named).
faculty_rationale: Confirm at full text when the assessment happens and what action it triggers (admission/disposition vs treatment-initiation). Sole-reviewer adjudication (faculty delegated, 2026-07-03).
